info.title: Kiorex Marketplace API
info.description: Platform connector for Kiorex (KX-01). Authenticate with HMAC headers. v1.2.0 (KX-09 Rev 2.3, additive): provider sync profession/edition/home-visit fields, serviceLocation+district on slots, visitAddress on holds, 422 OUT_OF_COVERAGE, care-plan-requests (P3 draft). The same client serves both Kiorly editions (Clinic and Nurse).

post.summary: Patient paid a clinic deposit link through Kiorex Pay (FS-04); held until check-in, applied via postRevenue

200.description: Deposit now HELD (replay returns the same deposit)

post.summary: Kiorex Pay collected a deposit for this booking; recorded as a held deposit, applied at check-in via postRevenue (KX-07)

currency.description: Must match the clinic market currency

200.description: Deposit (idempotent replay returns the same deposit)

post.summary: Kiorex paid out collected deposits to the clinic (KX-07 reconciliation)

depositPaymentRefs.description: paymentRefs of the deposits this payout covers

get.summary: Paged provider profiles for Kiorex resync

200.description: OK. v1.2.0 adds profession, edition, serviceLocations[], coverageDistricts[], verification.register, assignsClinician (agencies).

parameters.name: serviceLocation
parameters.description: v1.2.0. Defaults to IN_CLINIC. HOME requires district.

parameters.name: district
parameters.description: v1.2.0. District code; required when serviceLocation=HOME.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: v1.2.0. Optional, with lng, for travel-time aware HOME slots.

200.description: OK. Slots now carry serviceLocation and district (v1.2.0).

422.description: OUT_OF_COVERAGE: the address district is not covered by the provider (KX-09 v2.3)

post.summary: Create slot hold (KX-04); v1.2.0 adds optional visitAddress (required for HOME visit types)

422.description: OUT_OF_COVERAGE, or visitAddress missing/invalid for a HOME visit type

channel.description: CLINIC_LINK when booked from the clinic's own booking page (KX-09); never commissioned

bookingPageSlug.description: Slug of the clinic/doctor booking page (KX-09)

400.description: BOOKING_PAGE_MISMATCH when the slug belongs to another clinic or doctor

422.description: OUT_OF_COVERAGE after a zone change (release the hold, show in-zone alternatives); the address is carried from the hold

post.summary: Patient cancels a booking; clinic policy enforced, deposit refund decided server-side (KX-06)

get.summary: Open marketplace slots per clinician per clinic-local day, for Kiorex liquidity (slots/day). Counts only, no PHI (additive, 1.1.0)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Clinic-local last day, inclusive; range max 30 days

200.description: Per LIVE listing per day open slot counts (based on the clinician's shortest marketplace-bookable type) plus per-day totals

400.description: Missing/invalid dates or range over 30 days

post.summary: Kiorex patient joins a clinic/doctor waitlist; idempotent on externalRef (additive, 1.1.0). Slots that open are offered via the WAITLIST_OFFER event

200.description: Waitlist entry (status WAITING | OFFERED | BOOKED | CANCELLED)

400.description: Invalid clinic, type, window or patient

403.description: No LIVE listing for the clinic/doctor

delete.summary: Kiorex patient leaves the waitlist; idempotent, withdraws a pending offer (additive, 1.1.0)

200.description: Waitlist entry (CANCELLED, or BOOKED if already booked)

post.summary: Patient accepts a WAITLIST_OFFER: Kiorly books the slot as a KIOREX_MARKETPLACE appointment with externalReference = waitlist ref (additive, 1.1.0)
Patient declines a WAITLIST_OFFER; the slot goes to the next person (additive, 1.1.0)
Kiorex pushes daily profile views per doctor; re-sending a day replaces it (KX-10)
Kiorex pushes a doctor's rating aggregate and recent verified reviews (KX-08)

200.description: { accepted, rejected[{ reviewId, reason: NOT_A_COMPLETED_VISIT | INVALID }] }

post.summary: Patient reschedules a booking; clinic policy enforced (KX-06)
KX-11 — upsert record-share consent scopes from the Kiorex patient app
DRAFT (phase P3, Nurse edition): request a multi-visit care plan; idempotent on requestRef (KX-09 v2.3)

200.description: Request received (replay of the same requestRef returns the original response)

422.description: CARE_PLANS_NOT_OFFERED (provider does not offer care plans) or OUT_OF_COVERAGE

post.summary: KNLAB01 (Nurse edition, contracts 1.6.0): Kiorex relays the lab's status for a hand-off, with the sanitized chain of custody and (on release) the secure link
post.description: Idempotent; the headline `status` is monotonic (a stale push answers 200 applied:false). `orderId` is the Kiorly LabOrderPlaced orderId (the ClinicalOrder id). Carries no results and no PHI: a status, custody events (type, time, temperature, NURSE|LAB) and, when RELEASED, reportId + secure link.

200.description: Applied, or already applied. Body {applied:boolean,status}: applied=false when a stale push would have moved the status backwards (custody still refreshes).

post.summary: Kiorex signed status / marketplace outbox receiver (KX-05)
post.description: Kiorly POSTs JSON envelopes when `KIOREX_OUTBOX_WEBHOOK_URL` is configured. Dedupe on `eventId` (same id = at-most-once processing on Kiorex side).

parameters.name: X-Kiorly-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC sha256 of `${timestamp}.${body}` with shared secret

Profession.description: ADR-029. Extensible by market pack: consumers must tolerate unknown values.

Edition.description: Organization.edition (ADR-031). Same API and client for both editions.

ServiceLocation.description: VisitType.serviceLocation (ADR-030). VIDEO is reserved and not part of this contract.

VisitAddress.description: Patient home address. Sent only on holds for HOME visit types; encrypted at rest and masked after 24 h by Kiorly. Never appears in events or analytics (district only).

district.description: District code from the provider's coverageDistricts[].

register.description: Professional register that verified the clinician (e.g. a syndicate register for the profession, KX-05 PRVER01).

ProviderV23Fields.description: Fields added to each item of GET /providers in v1.2.0 (KX-09 Rev 2.3). All optional for backward compatibility; Kiorly Clinic emits them from v2.3.

serviceLocations.description: Locations the provider offers; HOME only when clinic.home_visits is effective.

coverageDistricts.description: District codes served for HOME visits. District-level only; no polygons or coordinates.

assignsClinician.description: Agencies only: the agency assigns a clinician after booking (HOME_VISIT_ASSIGNED event).

ProviderList.description: Paged provider profiles. Existing fields are unchanged; only the v2.3 additions are described here and the item schema tolerates additional properties.

Slot.description: Bookable slot. startsAt/endsAt are unchanged; v1.2.0 adds serviceLocation and district.

district.description: District code for HOME slots; null/absent for IN_CLINIC.

SlotHoldRequest.description: visitAddress is optional in the schema but REQUIRED by Kiorly for visit types whose serviceLocation is HOME (422 otherwise).

alternatives.description: In-zone alternatives, when Kiorly can offer them.

OutOfCoverageError.description: The address district is not (or no longer) covered. On book: release the hold and show in-zone alternatives (KX-09 §08).

CarePlanRequest.description: DRAFT (phase P3, Nurse edition). Narrowest shape; subject to change until ratified.

requestRef.description: Idempotency key; a replay returns the original response.

carePlanId.description: Set once the provider confirms (CARE_PLAN_CONFIRMED event).
